## Summary

Describe the component, bug fix, documentation change, or WordPress integration improvement.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run ci` passes
- [ ] behavior was tested with JavaScript enabled
- [ ] no-JavaScript/progressive-enhancement behavior was considered where relevant
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` behavior was tested for motion changes
- [ ] setup/cleanup lifecycle was checked for new GSAP or ScrollTrigger behavior
- [ ] screenshots or a short recording are included for visible UI changes when useful

## Performance and accessibility

Explain any impact on asset loading, ScrollTrigger instances, event listeners, layout work, keyboard behavior, focus, or reduced-motion support.

## Notes

Do not include client credentials, private project data, premium-plugin source, or other sensitive material.
